title: Rational design of Au@Pd core–shell cocatalyst on titanium dioxide enabling selective photocatalytic formation of deuterated alkane from lauric acid and heavy water
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1193-1201
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08602G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haifan Huang, Hisao Yoshida
The optimized catalyst has a core–shell structure comprising an Au-rich core, an Au–Pd mixed transition layer, and a Pd-rich surface shell, which enhances charge separation and promotes the formation of deuterated compounds.
